Normalize tags to lowercase, trim them, reject empty/invalid tags, de-duplicate and sort them, and remain compatible with stored tasks lacking tags. Support existing JSON conventions. Preserve all existing commands, add focused fixture-owned tests, and run the repository-owned test command. Separately create `assets/tags.txt` and integrate it so successful non-JSON tag changes display the banner once, while JSON output is banner-free. The asset must be exactly 12 lines, every line 20-48 characters, ASCII only, use only spaces plus `A-Z 0-9 + | / \ _ * . # ( ) : = -`, contain the literal `TAGS`, have no trailing whitespace, and end with one newline.

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$legacyDataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'legacy-tasks.json'
$bannerPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'assets/tags.txt'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @(
        'add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test',
        '--tags', ' Urgent, Backend,urgent ', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json'
    )
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'
    Assert-True (($added.tags -join ',') -eq 'backend,urgent') 'add should normalize, de-duplicate, and sort tags'

    $secondAdd = Invoke-TaskForge @(
        'add', '--title', 'Second task', '--tags', 'frontend,urgent',
        '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json'
    )
    Assert-True ($secondAdd.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should accept another tagged task'

    $thirdAdd = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Third task', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($thirdAdd.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should allow omitted tags'
    Assert-True (@(($thirdAdd.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).tags).Count -eq 0) 'add should store an empty tag array when tags are omitted'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 3) 'list should return all stored tasks'

    $repeatFilter = Invoke-TaskForge @(
        'list', '--tag', 'URGENT', '--tag', ' backend ', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json'
    )
    $repeatMatches = @($repeatFilter.Output | ConvertFrom-Json)
    Assert-True ($repeatFilter.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should accept repeatable tag filters'
    Assert-True ($repeatMatches.Count -eq 1 -and $repeatMatches[0].id -eq 1) 'repeatable tag filters should use AND semantics'

    $commaFilter = Invoke-TaskForge @(
        'list', '--tag', 'urgent,frontend', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json'
    )
    $commaMatches = @($commaFilter.Output | ConvertFrom-Json)
    Assert-True ($commaMatches.Count -eq 1 -and $commaMatches[0].id -eq 2) 'comma-separated tag filters should use AND semantics'

    $noMatches = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--tag', 'missing', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True (@($noMatches.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 0) 'list should return an empty JSON array when no tags match'

    $tagAdd = Invoke-TaskForge @('tag', '--id', '3', '--add', ' ZETA ', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($tagAdd.ExitCode -eq 0) 'tag --add should succeed'
    Assert-True ((($tagAdd.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).tags -join ',') -eq 'zeta') 'tag --add should normalize its tag'
    Assert-True (-not $tagAdd.Output.Contains('TAGS')) 'JSON tag output should not contain the banner'

    $tagAlpha = Invoke-TaskForge @('tag', '--id', '3', '--add', 'alpha', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ((($tagAlpha.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).tags -join ',') -eq 'alpha,zeta') 'tag --add should keep tags sorted'

    $tagDuplicate = Invoke-TaskForge @('tag', '--id', '3', '--add', 'ZETA', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ((($tagDuplicate.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).tags -join ',') -eq 'alpha,zeta') 'tag --add should de-duplicate tags'

    $tagRemove = Invoke-TaskForge @('tag', '--id', '3', '--remove', ' ZETA ', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ((($tagRemove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).tags -join ',') -eq 'alpha') 'tag --remove should normalize and remove its tag'

    $bannerChange = Invoke-TaskForge @('tag', '--id', '3', '--add', 'banner', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    $bannerFirstLine = Get-Content -LiteralPath $bannerPath -TotalCount 1
    $bannerLineCount = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $bannerPath).Count
    $bannerOccurrences = [regex]::Matches(
        $bannerChange.Output,
        [regex]::Escape($bannerFirstLine)
    ).Count
    Assert-True ($bannerChange.ExitCode -eq 0) 'non-JSON tag changes should succeed'
    Assert-True ($bannerLineCount -eq 12) 'the tag banner fixture should have 12 lines'
    Assert-True ($bannerOccurrences -eq 1) 'non-JSON tag changes should display the banner exactly once'
    Assert-True (($bannerChange.Output -split "`n").Count -eq 13) 'non-JSON tag changes should output one banner and one result line'

    $missingMutation = Invoke-TaskForge @('tag', '--id', '3', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missingMutation.ExitCode -ne 0) 'tag should require either --add or --remove'

    $conflictingMutation = Invoke-TaskForge @(
        'tag', '--id', '3', '--add', 'one', '--remove', 'two', '--data-file', $dataFile
    )
    Assert-True ($conflictingMutation.ExitCode -ne 0) 'tag should reject using --add and --remove together'

    $multipleMutation = Invoke-TaskForge @('tag', '--id', '3', '--add', 'one,two', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($multipleMutation.ExitCode -ne 0) 'tag should require exactly one tag value'

    $invalidAdd = Invoke-TaskForge @(
        'add', '--title', 'Invalid tags', '--tags', 'good,,bad', '--data-file', $dataFile
    )
    Assert-True ($invalidAdd.ExitCode -ne 0) 'add should reject empty comma-separated tags'

    $invalidFilter = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--tag', 'not valid!', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($invalidFilter.ExitCode -ne 0) 'list should reject invalid tag characters'

    $duplicateTitle = Invoke-TaskForge @(
        'add', '--title', 'One', '--title', 'Two', '--data-file', $dataFile
    )
    Assert-True ($duplicateTitle.ExitCode -ne 0) 'non-repeatable options should still reject duplicates'

    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
        $legacyDataFile,
        '[{"id":9,"title":"Legacy task","description":"","status":"pending","createdAt":"2020-01-01T00:00:00Z"}]',
        [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
    )
    $legacyList = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $legacyDataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True (@($legacyList.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should support stored tasks without tags'
    $legacyFiltered = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--tag', 'anything', '--data-file', $legacyDataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True (@($legacyFiltered.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 0) 'tag filters should treat missing stored tags as empty'
    $legacyTag = Invoke-TaskForge @('tag', '--id', '9', '--add', 'Migrated', '--data-file', $legacyDataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ((($legacyTag.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).tags -join ',') -eq 'migrated') 'tag should add a tag property to legacy tasks'
    $legacyUntag = Invoke-TaskForge @('tag', '--id', '9', '--remove', 'migrated', '--data-file', $legacyDataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True (@(($legacyUntag.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).tags).Count -eq 0) 'tag should persist an empty array after removing the last tag'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'

    $emptyDataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'empty-tasks.json'
    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $emptyDataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('TaskForge')) 'help should succeed'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    "PASS: TaskForge fixture assertions"
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
